entry_state: Chapter 2 is complete through physical 61. The synthetic company, bounded real-package connection and paired future settlements preserve explicit assumptions and unknowns. Original versus later source views stay separate; the JPMorgan literal-page and navigation proposal has its own issuer dependencies, no Apple posting consequence and no observed human acceptance. Chapter 3 must now explain how source assertions, alternative histories and clocks are represented.
exit_state: Chapter 3 has connected Northstar and Apple to immutable assertions, context-sensitive mappings, separate clocks and dated company boundaries. Coverage denominators and unresolved references remain explicit. Partition axes cannot be added together; eligible supersession is assertion-specific. Extraction, translation, model admission and accounting eligibility are four distinct decisions. FIFO and straight-line policy statements do not supply lots, lives or actual holdings; the ASBE substitution presumption needs its own premises. Section 3.10 has begun the JPMorgan 156-versus-163 reference discrepancy, with its sentence continuing onto page 68. Chapter 3 is not yet complete.
findings: No new confirmed defect on actual rendered physical pages 62–67.
Completed the eight introductory representation sections and the first source-admission section; the JPMorgan reference discussion remains open.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.entry_belief: The company examples require evidence richer than a row name and a reported number.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.open_question: What must an immutable observation retain before an analyst derives a financial interpretation?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.parent_contribution: The source/context/amount/meaning/timing/review fields define the historical assertion that later transformations must preserve.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.belief_update: Source text, precision, missingness and review history travel with a reported value; qualitative substantially-all language does not assert a numeric fixed-rate share.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.exit_question: When do differently named or measured assertions refer to comparable financial quantities?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.removal_verdict: Without these fields the representation could overwrite a company statement with an analyst's reconstruction and lose the original uncertainty.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.swap_verdict: Immutable assertions must precede mappings because a mapping relates contextual records rather than bare labels.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.entry_verdict: The opening names notes, policies and subsequent announcements, making document coverage broader than a financial-statement table.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.exit_verdict: The qualitative fixed-rate example shows exactly why an inferred threshold needs separate analyst provenance.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.promise_verdict: The table supplies minimum observation contents and the narrative paragraph explains the extra modality fields without claiming complete public disclosure.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.distinct_contribution_verdict: It establishes what the historical source record is before any equivalence, temporal selection or accounting computation is applied.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.entry_belief: Each observed amount now has context, source identity and a proposed meaning.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.open_question: Can a common debt label or taxonomy ancestor justify substituting one measurement for another?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.parent_contribution: Debt principal, amortised cost and fair value motivate explicit mapping relationships and separate accounting bases.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.belief_update: Many-to-many mappings may relate extensions to broader concepts, but aggregation cannot silently transform measurement or convert accounting standards.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.exit_question: Which reporting, availability and database dates govern the selected assertion?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.removal_verdict: Removing this distinction would allow label matching to masquerade as IFRS/US GAAP/ASBE conversion.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.swap_verdict: Meaning comes after assertion fields and before temporal queries so a query cannot select ostensibly matching but incompatible amounts.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.entry_verdict: The debt examples immediately explain why several correct amounts may coexist for the same date.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.exit_verdict: The tax-loss, deferred-tax and regulatory-deduction example extends the distinction to measurements of one economic loss.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.promise_verdict: The section establishes relationship categories and basis preservation; detailed mapping composition is deferred explicitly to the later procedure.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.distinct_contribution_verdict: It separates financial meaning from vocabulary without requiring one universal company chart of accounts.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.entry_belief: Amounts with comparable concepts can still belong to different information sets.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.open_question: Which clock answers an economic-period, investor-information or system-history question?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.parent_contribution: The machine example distinguishes validity, reporting, publication and ingestion before defining view and interval rules.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.belief_update: Database transaction time cannot replace investor availability; year-to-date subtraction requires matched contexts and revisions, with correlated rounding retained.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.exit_question: How does a change in the reporting perimeter alter otherwise comparable balances?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.removal_verdict: Without the separate clocks a later restatement could leak into an earlier forecast merely because it concerns an earlier period.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.swap_verdict: Temporal semantics must be established before perimeter changes and the later assertion-selection algorithm.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.entry_verdict: The November/December/March/April sequence supplies concrete meanings before the database citation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.exit_verdict: The closing distinguishes prospective estimates, restatement and opening adjustments instead of assigning one effect to every revision flag.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.promise_verdict: Half-open intervals, named views and compatible flow subtraction are specified while unusual calendars require explicit calendar objects.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.distinct_contribution_verdict: It makes information availability and financial-period arithmetic independent of storage recency.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.entry_belief: Temporal compatibility is necessary but does not identify the company population behind a balance.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.open_question: Which entity, group and exposure relationships explain a change in reported property or intragroup claims?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.parent_contribution: Dated ownership/control relationships and separate consolidation adjustments introduce the changing company boundary.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.belief_update: An increase in property may come from acquisition, translation or revaluation; unmatched eliminations stay unresolved rather than becoming invented transactions.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.exit_question: What other hidden histories or exposures survive an apparently reconciled balance?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.removal_verdict: Deleting the boundary discussion would let acquisitions be extrapolated as capex and majority ownership stand in for a supported control conclusion.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.swap_verdict: Perimeter belongs after time because ownership and control are dated, and before the catalogue of other representation problems.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.entry_verdict: The opening distinguishes legal entity, reporting group and economic exposure before giving the property bridge counterexample.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.exit_verdict: Constant-perimeter analysis is labelled a derived modelling assumption rather than the source's original report.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.promise_verdict: The section names the necessary relationships and event distinctions without pretending that a graph alone supplies consolidation judgments.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.distinct_contribution_verdict: It prevents population changes from being confused with transactions within an unchanged company.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.entry_belief: Comparable concepts, dates and perimeters still leave multiple economic histories compatible with one balance.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.open_question: Which additional distinctions must the representation preserve to support a future scenario?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.parent_contribution: Recognition versus settlement, gross versus net flows, currencies, asset vintages and contingent exposures expand the state requirements.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.belief_update: Equal closing debt can conceal different borrowing/repayment paths, translation is not cash, and strategic responses require explicit policies rather than balance identities.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.exit_question: How does an importer account for all disclosed material before proposing executable constraints?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.removal_verdict: Without these counterexamples a complete-looking record could omit liquidity needs, off-balance exposures or behaviour essential to simulation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.swap_verdict: The broader risks follow the four basic representation dimensions and motivate the concrete coverage procedure next.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.entry_verdict: The four-period sale/invoice/receipt/impairment example immediately exposes the inadequacy of a single recognition date.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.exit_verdict: The closing bank and insurer responses show why accounting identities cannot determine behavioural policy.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.promise_verdict: The survey makes retained distinctions explicit; it does not claim calibrated policies or solved recovery assumptions.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.distinct_contribution_verdict: It tests the representation against economically relevant information that may be invisible in reported net stocks.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.entry_belief: Many important facts can hide in notes, cross-references and qualitative commitments.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.open_question: How can coverage be assessed without equating extracted pages with reviewed financial meaning?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.parent_contribution: A frozen filing package, stable content units and a bounded cross-reference work list define a reproducible coverage procedure.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.belief_update: Acquired-document, semantic and simulation coverage have distinct denominators; unavailable or ambiguous references remain obligations and narrative quantifiers retain their scope.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.exit_question: Once assertions are located and interpreted, what evidence permits their aggregation or transformation?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.removal_verdict: Omitting the procedure would make successful extraction look like incorporated-package closure and let a may-repurchase permission become a compulsory payment.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.swap_verdict: Coverage precedes mapping because mapping an incomplete or unreviewed assertion inventory cannot establish disclosure completeness.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.entry_verdict: The importer begins with hashes, reporting dates and availability evidence before comparing contents with detected headings.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.exit_verdict: The closing separates extraction acceptance from translation acceptance using coupon, repurchase and guarantee examples.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.promise_verdict: The traversal has a visited-key and resource-limit stop rule, while unresolved targets and an incomplete semantic denominator remain visible.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.distinct_contribution_verdict: It turns source completeness into an inspectable accounting of units and references without inventing missing financial semantics.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.entry_belief: A retained assertion may be compared with other concepts only through a reviewed relationship.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.open_question: Which mapping operations preserve meaning, and when does summing classifications double count revenue?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.parent_contribution: Applicability fields, relationship composition and disjoint/exhaustive partitions make mappings financially operational.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.belief_update: Northstar's geography and channel each total 260, so their combined 520 is invalid; margins do not identify joint cells, and Apple's vendor receivable is not ordinary trade revenue.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.exit_question: How are original and revised instances of these contextual concepts selected?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.removal_verdict: Without the explicit partition and transformation rules, component labels could justify duplicate aggregation or a false measurement conversion.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.swap_verdict: The detailed mapping procedure follows the coverage inventory and precedes selection across revisions of the mapped assertions.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.entry_verdict: The record fields include basis, period, dimensions, evidence and any actual transformation rather than offering a name dictionary.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.exit_verdict: Gross derivative amounts and mandatory recognition rules limit what company extensions or presentation changes can do.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.promise_verdict: The composition rules and two financial counterexamples explain permitted uses; unallocated members remain explicit rather than zero.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.distinct_contribution_verdict: It supplies the financial tests that prevent vocabulary alignment from creating false additivity or equivalence.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.entry_belief: Contextual mappings alone do not decide which revision belongs in an answer.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.open_question: How should availability cutoffs and targeted supersession select assertions without erasing conflicts?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.parent_contribution: The eligibility filter and acyclic supersession traversal give the earlier clock distinctions an explicit query procedure.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.belief_update: A superseder must itself be eligible; conflicting maximal assertions both survive, and a revenue correction does not automatically replace every note or basis.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.exit_question: What substantive authority is conferred by accepting an extracted and translated assertion?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.removal_verdict: Removing the algorithm would leave file order or ingestion recency as an accidental rule for historical truth.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.swap_verdict: Selection needs the prior context and clock definitions; it should precede the separation of source-reading and accounting eligibility.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.entry_verdict: The opening states availability first and optional database time second, including a conservative rule for day-only publication metadata.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.exit_verdict: The return to Northstar's explicit query fixture connects prospective estimates and comparative corrections to an already worked case.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.promise_verdict: Original, latest-available and harmonised views have separate operations, while unresolved competing corrections remain retained.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:8.distinct_contribution_verdict: It determines which assertion versions may answer a query without rewriting the stored historical record.

sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.entry_belief: An eligible source assertion can be transcribed and interpreted faithfully while still lacking inputs for an accounting calculation.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.open_question: Does accepting FIFO or straight-line policy language establish the actual lots, asset lives or method applicability?
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.parent_contribution: The four decisions distinguish extraction, translation, model admission and event-specific accounting eligibility.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.belief_update: Company policy passages constrain only their stated scope; they supply neither missing holdings nor an accounting-authority determination, and ASBE's substitution presumption requires its own conditions.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.exit_question: What happens when faithful transcription preserves an erroneous reference in the original filing?
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.removal_verdict: Without this separation one approved flag could convert a true quotation into an unsupported reconstruction or compliance conclusion.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.swap_verdict: Admission follows assertion selection so the chosen source and information view are known before its use is evaluated.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.entry_verdict: FIFO and depreciation link directly to the earlier Apple asset examples, exposing which economic inputs remain missing.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.exit_verdict: The ASBE Article 6 example distinguishes a source-prescribed conditional presumption from an analyst's arbitrary threshold.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.promise_verdict: The six policy passages have preserved slices and proposed predicates, while actual human acceptance and comprehensive authority remain unclaimed.
sections/source-admission.tex:section:1.distinct_contribution_verdict: It prevents faithful reading, a modelling choice and an applicable accounting treatment from sharing one evidentiary meaning.
